questions.question: What plans did David give to Solomon?
options: Plans for the temple and its courts
Plans for the walls of the holy city
Plans for the new army of the kingdom
Plans for the royal palace and gardens
questions.answer: Plans for the temple and its courts

questions.question: What did David charge Solomon to do regarding God?
options: Gather a great army for war
Fear the kings of the nations
Know and serve God with a whole heart
Build many great cities across the land
questions.answer: Know and serve God with a whole heart

questions.question: David said the plan for the temple came to him in writing from the hand of the LORD.
David told Solomon, 'Be strong and courageous and do it... for the LORD God, even my God, is with _____.'
If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will _____ you forever.
